⚡ Quick Setup

Import this workflow into your n8n instance

🔧 How it Works

• MCP Trigger: Serves as your server endpoint for AI agent requests
• Tool Nodes: Pre-configured for every One Simple API Tool operation
• AI Expressions: Automatically populate parameters via $fromAI() placeholders
• Native Integration: Uses official n8n One Simple API Tool tool with full error handling

📋 Available Operations (10 total)

Every possible One Simple API Tool operation is included:

🔧 Information (2 operations)

• Convert a value between currencies
• Get image metadata from a URL

🔧 Socialprofile (2 operations)

• Get details about an Instagram profile
• Get details about a Spotify artist

🔧 Utility (3 operations)

• Expand a shortened URL
• Generate a QR code utility
• Validate an email address

🔧 Website (3 operations)

• Generate PDF
• Get SEO Data
• Screenshot

🤖 AI Integration

Parameter Handling: AI agents automatically provide values for:
• Resource IDs and identifiers
• Search queries and filters
• Content and data payloads
• Configuration options

Response Format: Native One Simple API Tool API responses with full data structure

Error Handling: Built-in n8n error management and retry logic

Connect this MCP server to any AI agent or workflow:
